text: Against the sunset sky, colored in warm shades of orange, gold and pink, stands an elderly but sturdy european man. His figure radiates calmness and confidence. His short, hair is slightly disheveled, as if he has just stepped out of his flying car to enjoy the moment. His wise gaze is staring off into the distance as if he's pondering something important, and the slight half-smile on his face suggests that he knows the answers to questions that haven't even been asked yet. He is dressed in a style that combines practicality and elegance: dark blue pants, a loose gray jacket, and a blue shirt with the collar unbuttoned. His posture is relaxed - he leans lightly on the hood of his flying car, which hovers a few centimeters above the ground. The car is a masterpiece of the future: black and streamlined, it seems almost alive. Its surface reflects the last rays of the setting sun, shimmering with shades of dark metal and bluish glow emanating from the anti-gravity panels.
